description: Manages user accounts, roles, and organizational unit settings within the system.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Get a paginated list of users with filtering and search capabilities. This endpoint supports advanced search using a request body. You can filter by `SearchTerm`, `RoleFilter`, `OrgUnitFilter`, and control pagination with `PageIndex` and `PageSize`. Sorting can be applied using `SortBy` and `SortDirection`.
example_uses: Find all users named 'John Doe'.
List the first 10 users in the 'Admin' role.
Get users from my organization unit, sorted by name.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of users, applying various filters, search terms, and pagination settings to narrow down the results.

endpoints.name: GetUser
endpoints.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific user by their unique ID.
example_uses: Get details for user 'U12345'.
Show me the profile of the user with ID 'abc-def-ghi'.
Retrieve information about a specific user.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch the complete profile and details of a single user, identified by their user ID.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserRoles
endpoints.description: Modify the roles assigned to a specific user. This operation requires a list of new roles to be provided in the request body.
example_uses: Change user 'U12345' roles to 'Admin' and 'Editor'.
Assign the 'Viewer' role to user 'abc-def-ghi'.
Update the permissions for a user.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to change or update the security roles associated with a particular user account.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieve a list of all roles that the currently authenticated user is authorized to assign to other users.
example_uses: What roles can I assign to new users?
List all assignable user roles.
Get the available role options.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to discover the roles that can be assigned to users, based on the current user's permissions.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserOrgUnit
endpoints.description: Retrieve the organizational unit code associated with the currently authenticated user. This can be used for filtering data specific to the user's organization.
example_uses: What is my current organization unit?
Get the organizational unit for the logged-in user.
Find out my default organizational filter.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get the organizational unit of the current user, often used for scoping data access or filtering.

endpoints.name: GetOrgUnitSelfManagement
endpoints.description: Retrieve the self-management setting for a specific organizational unit. This indicates whether users within that unit can manage certain aspects of their own accounts.
example_uses: Is self-management enabled for 'HQ' organization unit?
Check the self-management status of org unit 'NY'.
Get the self-management setting for a given organizational unit.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to check if self-management features are enabled for a particular organizational unit.

endpoints.name: UpdateOrgUnitSelfManagement
endpoints.description: Update the self-management setting for a specific organizational unit. This allows enabling or disabling self-service features for users within that unit.
example_uses: Enable self-management for the 'HQ' organization unit.
Disable self-management for org unit 'NY'.
Set the self-management option for an organizational unit.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to change whether users in a specific organizational unit can manage their own settings or roles.
